description: This file exports constants and functions related to a flowchart rendering module, including module ID, modules object, and internal functions for manipulating SVG elements and styling. It appears to be part of a larger chart or diagram rendering library.

methods.name: o
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element has children with a specific label.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing a node with 'v', 'w', and 'name' properties.

methods.description: Sets style attributes on an SVG element.
